statement: I bring quantitative rigor and business judgment together to make better investment and strategy decisions.

facts.label: Now
facts.text: M.S. in Financial Economics, Columbia Business School

story.title: Who I am
story.lead: A finance and quantitative analyst who likes the moment a model finally explains what the market is doing.
paragraphs: Across private equity, investment banking, asset management, and a founding team, my approach has stayed the same: get the numbers right, understand the business behind them, and turn the result into a decision someone can act on.

story.title: How I think
paragraphs: Numbers first. Screening 250+ acquisition targets on growth, margins, leverage, and cash flow taught me that consistent quantitative standards beat instinct, especially when the list is long.
Understand the business behind them. Reading 10-Ks to map a sector’s value chain is slow, but it is how you know whether a multiple is cheap or just deserved.
Automate the repeatable. At Khelp, turning performance tracking into a Python pipeline cut reconciliation errors by about 35% and gave the team back its time.

story.title: What I’m exploring
paragraphs: How quantitative methods can improve portfolio construction across both traditional and digital assets, and what it takes to turn a policy-driven market opportunity into a fundable business.
I work on both sides of that question: modelling cross-asset behaviour in Python, and building the financial case for an early-stage company from the founding team.

whatIDo.title: Quantitative analysis
whatIDo.text: Return correlation and volatility models, portfolio construction experiments, and rule-based screens in Python and Excel.

whatIDo.title: Investment research
whatIDo.text: 10-K analysis, comparable company models, financial durability assessments, and buy-side recommendations.

whatIDo.title: Strategy and fundraising
whatIDo.text: Market segmentation, financial projections, and investor materials for an early-stage company.

beyond.title: Beyond work
beyond.text: On stage with Emory A Cappella, on the volleyball court, on the ski slopes, and behind a drawing tablet or a camera. Between Atlanta and New York, always up for something new.
